name: raiseai-site
description: Static site for raiseai.in. No runtime build; Tailwind CSS is pre-generated into assets/ and committed.

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c build/tw-funnel.config.js -i build/tw.in.css -o assets/tw-funnel.css --minify && tailwindcss -c build/tw-home.config.js -i build/tw.in.css -o assets/tw-home.css --minify
